labels.effectWithoutDefer: Core owns the startup timer and AbortController. The guarded claim aborts sleep on success or close.
labels.stateOutsideCell: RootLifetime and Layer own startup, cancellation, panic, and teardown state. This is Core state, not application state.
labels.awaitsSyncWork: Close yields one microtask so the first close retains its promise before startup joins it. The remaining waits are required cleanup.
labels.waitsOnSideWork: The public startup and close lifecycle waits for its hooks and cleanup. Normal runs do not enter this path.
labels.shapeGrowsPerCall: Startup and late error records are cold Core state. No field or work is added to a successful plain run.
